Nature publishes landmark papers, award winning news, leading comment and expert opinion on important, topical scientific news and events that enable readers to share the latest discoveries in science and evolve the discussion amongst the global scientific community.

item.title: [8] Octupole-driven spin torque switching of antiferromagnetic tunnel junctions
item.content:encoded:
Last authors: James M. Rondinelli, Pedram Khalili Amiri

Authors: Jaimin Kang, Mohammad Hamdi, Shun Kong Cheung, et al.

Score 8/10 B_IMPORTANT_CONDMAT

Why: Important experimental spintronics paper on antiferromagnetic materials and magnetic memory.

Tags: #magnetism #spintronics #antiferromagnet #experimental #magneticmemory

Abstract: All-antiferromagnetic tunnel junctions can display both a large TMR and a reciprocal switching effect, octupole-driven spin-transfer torque, enabling nanoscale magnetic memory and potentially room-temperature terahertz spintronic devices.

item.title: [6] Additive manufacturing of ultralong and architected single crystals
item.content:encoded:
Last authors: Daining Fang, Y. Morris Wang

Authors: Changmeng Liu, Yinan Cui, Jiachen Wang, et al.

Score 6/10 C_MAYBE

Why: Materials synthesis methodology for single crystals of refractory metals, potentially relevant for CM.

Tags: #methodology #materialssynthesis #metals

Abstract: A free-form additive manufacturing method that uses alternating and pulsed heat inputs is described for fabricating metre-tall, centimetre-diameter single crystals of Ti-6Al-4V, as well as hard-to-process refractory metals, including W, Mo, Nb and MoNb alloys.
